data.rationale: The proposal has the same filter steps in the same order (Careers → Openings → Country/Team/Time Type, each with search-and-select → Search → open the job and apply) and the right country, team and time_type parameters, but it makes the final job step optional and hard-codes 'APPLY NOW' instead of naming an {action} parameter (open vs. save).
